ios.desc:
We track sleep, fitness, and screen time - but rarely our social health.

TimeWith helps you see how much meaningful time you spend with the people who matter most, so you can stay connected with intention instead of letting relationships drift.

Think of it as a fitness tracker for your social life.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add the people who matter most to you
• Log interactions in seconds, or import them from your calendar
• Watch your Connection Score evolve over time
• Review your Weekly Digest to spot patterns and relationship drift

KEY FEATURES
• Connection Score: A simple 0-100 score showing how connected and present you've been recently.
• Weekly Digest: See trends in your social life over time and identify who you may be drifting from.
• Calendar Integration: Automatically import events so tracking takes almost no effort.
• People & Groups: Organize your relationships into circles like Family, Close Friends, and Work.
• Privacy First: No ads, no contact scraping, no location tracking. Your data stays yours.
• Calm by Design: Fast and lightweight, built to feel reflective - not addictive.

TIMEWITH PRO
Unlock unlimited people, calendars, and full history. Free users can track up to 10 people with 90 days of history.

Your relationships are your most important investment. TimeWith helps you see where your time goes.

quotes.text:
A paternity leave passion project designed to measure your "social fitness" the same way Whoop and Oura measure physical wellness.

The app tracks who you spend time with and gives you a Connection Score (both overall and per person).

A core question I'd value input on:
- Does the same measure-then-improve premise for health, productivity, etc. work for relationships or break down because it's too challenging to score meaningfully?

App store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/timewith/id6760588260
Landing page: https://timewith.app
